snippet.title: Not Raised By Wolves - Vancouver Film School (VFS)
snippet.description:
Not Raised by Wolves is a single-player third-person shooter where the player assumes the role of La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger delving into an ancient AI facility to rescue her colony’s pups. The player is equipped with a versatile revolver with dual firing modes and an electric drone companion to deal with the array of unique enemies standing between them victory. NRBW was made in Unity by a team of 5 students and 3 collaborators over 5 months.

This game was nominated for Unity's Best Student Project Award! Support Not Raised By Wolves and VOTE here: 

https://awards.unity.com/

Congratulations to the creators: 

Main Team

Jose Karlo Hurtado Corona
Yurii Lobus
Luis Masiá
Konrad McLeod
John Newton

Collaborators

Adrei Bardas - Main Character Animations
Joshua Erickson - Sound Design
Jiaxing Shi - Sound Design

SUBSCRIBE to our channel for more content from our talented students and alumni!

Hit the bell icon to be instantly notified when we upload a new video!

For more info our programs, scholarships and admissions visit our website at www.vfs.edu
